# About Culture Things
> Three thoughtfully paced, local-led small-group experiences in Portugal. Prices are per person and charged in EUR.

## Booking facts
- Website languages: EN, PT, ES, FR, DE.
- Tours are guided only in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
- Day tours include pickup and return in Lisbon; the exact address is requested at checkout.
- Day tours have up to 8 guests; the Sintra walking tour has up to 10.
- Monument tickets and meals are excluded unless expressly stated.
- Full refund for cancellation at least 48 hours before departure.

## Current experiences
- Sintra, Cabo da Roca & Cascais — 8 hours — €119/person — Lisbon, Sintra, one key monument, Cabo da Roca, Cascais, Lisbon.
- Sintra Walking Tour — 3 hours — €45/person — central Sintra, history, architecture, viewpoints and local recommendations.
- Fátima, Nazaré & Óbidos — 9 hours — €129/person — Lisbon, Fátima, Nazaré, Óbidos, Lisbon.
